name: Helion Manufacturing Conductive Thread Undersuit
description:
A base layer woven with conductive thread pathways that carry low-voltage electrical signals across the body, serving as a wearable circuit board. Augmentation hardware installed in different body locations can communicate through the suit's conductive network instead of requiring internal wiring.

Designed for heavily augmented individuals whose implants need a unified communication bus. The undersuit eliminates the need for subdermal wiring between augmentation sites — a cheaper, less invasive, and reversible alternative to permanent internal networking.
functionality: External augmentation networking, low-voltage signal routing, implant communication bus
what_it_says: Your body is a network and this suit is the wiring you can take off at the end of the day.
story_hooks: A Conductive Thread Undersuit begins routing signals between augmentation sites that weren't programmed to communicate — the suit's network has connected systems that were intentionally isolated.
